messages:
elena: Quick live thread from today's all-hands — ask short Qs about mission, positioning, market, competitors. I'll answer in-line for 20m. :sparkles:

omar: Are we still positioning as "developer-first" or shifting to "platform for enterprises"?

elena: Developer-first stays. We add enterprise overlays (SLA, private deploys). Messaging: "developer-first, enterprise-ready." Keep it consistent.

zoe: What's the single clearest way to explain our edge vs cloud-managed endpoints?

elena: "Predictable unit economics + the same runtime across hosted, dedicated, and private." That highlights cost and migration risk.

matt_p: Competitors: what messaging vs OSS runtimes that emphasize low-cost inference?

elena: Acknowledge cost but call out ops and time-to-prod. Customers rarely choose cheapest if reliability and SLAs matter.

sara: For sales enablement: can we get 3 bullets to use on calls?

elena: Sure: 1) Same API across environments; 2) Cost controls & Optimize tooling; 3) SLO-backed Dedicated + fallbacks. I'll push a 1-slide summary.

ops-bot: Reminder: all-hands recording uploaded -> https://drive.internal/redwood/all-hands/179999

omar: Roadmap quick: autoscaling and cache improvements vs multimodal — what first?

elena: Autoscaling/cache first (widest impact). Multimodal remains research/experimental until we hit reliability parity.

zoe: Model catalog onboarding criteria — perf only or license/community too?

elena: Perf + license compatibility + quality checks. Community traction helps but doesn't override license/perf.

matt_p: Can leadership post a short FAQ for customer-facing teams?

elena: Yes — will drop a 1-page FAQ and three talking bullets in enablement by EOD tomorrow. Ping me for follow-ups.

elena: Thanks all — keeping this short. DM if you need deeper syncs. :rocket:
